name: openbb_economy_gdp
description:
Nominal GDP for a country through the OpenBB Platform (obb.economy.gdp.nominal).
Returns: {country, data_points, gdp_data: [records with date, country and value]} or {country, error}.
Inputs (* required): country (OECD-style name in lower case with underscores, e.g. united_states, germany, japan; default united_states); provider (oecd or econdb; default oecd, no key).
US real GDP: av_gdp, fred_gdp; growth: fred_gdp_growth. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"country": "germany", "provider": "oecd"}

country.description: Country name or code (e.g., united_states, germany, japan)
